title: Terms & Conditions
intro: These terms apply to your use of the SAGAR2027 conference website. By using this site, you agree to use it responsibly and in accordance with these terms.

sections.title: About this website
paragraphs: This website provides information about SAGAR2027, the International Conference on Soft Computing Application in Smart Grid and Renewable Energy, organized by ABIT (Autonomous).

sections.title: Use of the website
paragraphs: You may use this website to learn about the conference, its program, venue, submission process, and registration. Do not misuse the website, interfere with its operation, or attempt to access systems or information without authorization.

sections.title: Conference information
paragraphs: Conference dates, schedules, fees, venue details, submission requirements, and other information may be updated. Please check the relevant pages for the latest information before making arrangements.

sections.title: Submissions and registration
paragraphs: Paper submissions, registration, reviews, and publication consideration are subject to the requirements and decisions stated in their respective conference pages and any applicable publisher or submission-platform terms.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Website content, branding, and materials belong to their respective owners. You may not reproduce or redistribute material from this site except as permitted by applicable law or with permission from the relevant rights holder.

sections.title: Third-party services and links
paragraphs: This website may link to third-party websites and services, including submission and analytics providers. Those services are governed by their own terms and policies; the conference organizers do not control their content or operation.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: These terms may be updated as the website or conference information changes. For questions about these terms, contact the SAGAR2027 organizing committee using the contact details on the website.
